elastic-collision.def: A collision in which the total kinetic energy of the system is the same before and after (momentum is also conserved).

inelastic-collision.def: A collision in which momentum is conserved but the total kinetic energy decreases, the difference becoming thermal energy, sound and deformation.

perfectly-inelastic.def: An inelastic collision in which the objects stick together and move with one common velocity, v_f = Σp/Σm.

momentum-bar-chart.def: Bars showing each object's momentum (with its sign) and the system total before and after an interaction; with no net external impulse, the totals match.
